description: HEU MODERATE Building Stock Data is a data set deposited in qjdr.hiukbn by its authors Simon Pezzutto (Eurac Research - Institute for Renewable Energy). The HEU MODERATE Building Stock Data provides information regarding the building stock for all EU27 member states at the national level (i.e., NUTS 0) considering 2020 as the reference year. Regarding the Service Sector, the data distinguishes the following subsectors: single-family houses, multifamily houses, and apartment blocks. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: Excel, CSV. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC BY 4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
